question: Where did the fifth session of the Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee (INC-5) to end plastic pollution take place?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Busan, South Korea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **fifth session of the Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee (INC-5)** to end plastic pollution was held in **Busan, South Korea.**
 
• This session is part of the global effort under the United Nations to develop an **international legally binding instrument** to address the issue of plastic pollution.
 
• The INC sessions are aimed at tackling the growing challenge of **plastic waste** and its impact on **marine ecosystems, human health, and biodiversity.**
 
• Busan is a significant location for hosting such international events due to its role as a **global hub for trade and environmental initiatives.**
 
• The sessions focus on the **life cycle of plastics**, covering production, design, waste management, and recycling.
 
• South Korea has been actively involved in **international environmental policies** and has taken measures to address **plastic waste management** within its borders.
 
• The INC-5 session is a continuation of the global series initiated by the **United Nations Environment Assembly (UNEA).**
 
• The meeting also emphasized the need for **collaborative efforts** among nations to curb plastic pollution through **policy frameworks, innovation, and public awareness campaigns.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tokyo, Japan**__

 __
 
• **Tokyo** is the capital city of Japan and a major global hub for **technology, innovation, and international diplomacy.**
 
• While Japan is actively involved in addressing **plastic pollution**, Tokyo was not the location for the INC-5 session.
 
• Japan has implemented various measures such as **plastic bag charges** to reduce plastic waste.
 
 
 
• **Nairobi, Kenya**__
 __
 
• **Nairobi** is the headquarters of the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).**
 
• The **first session** of the INC to combat plastic pollution was held in Nairobi, highlighting its importance as a center for **environmental negotiations.**
 
• Kenya has been a pioneer in **plastic bag bans**, showcasing its commitment to combating pollution.
 
 
 
• **Berlin, Germany**__
 
 
• **Berlin** is a leading city in Europe for hosting **climate and environmental policy discussions.**
 
• Germany has one of the most advanced **waste management systems** in the world and plays a key role in global efforts to reduce plastic pollution.
 
• Although Berlin was not chosen for INC-5, Germany has been actively participating in the INC sessions.
